intent: 金色的细小尘埃粒子在黑背景上缓慢上升，微微发光
pass_criteria: small golden/amber glowing particles on a near-black background
upward drift readable between t1 and t4 frames
fine dust scale — many small particles, not few large blobs
soft glow, additive feel; no flat matte dots

params: Use a wide Box emitter so many fine particles are born across the frame rather than from one obvious point.
Enable individual emitter dimensions before setting the vertical source area.
Span beyond the comp width for an edge-to-edge dust field.
Fill most of the frame height at birth so frame 1 already contains a rich dust field.
Place the emitter around the composition center for an even atmospheric distribution.
Maintain many visible particles while preserving a fine dust character.
Keep random birth velocity very low so the overall motion remains slow and calm.
Use Uniform direction for naturally varied micro-drift instead of a rigid stream.
Open the motion into an organic all-around dust distribution.
Keep particles alive long enough to create a continuous suspended field.
Use tiny particle cores appropriate for fine airborne dust.
Vary particle scale so the dust does not look mechanically uniform.
Keep cores delicate while allowing additive overlaps to build brightness.
Vary opacity for subtle sparkle and depth.
Set particle color mode to At Birth so the warm amber color is applied.
Tint the particles a rich golden amber.
Use Glow Sphere particles for luminous soft-edged dust rather than flat dots.
Apply negative gravity to create a slow, clearly readable upward rise.
Use Add blending so overlapping dust has a light-emissive additive feel.
Give each tiny core a compact soft halo.
Keep the per-particle halo subtle and prevent the field becoming foggy.
Enable air resistance so turbulence can affect particle positions.
Add restrained turbulence for delicate floating motion.
Use broad turbulence features rather than noisy jitter.
Enable motion blur for the few faster drifting grains.
expressions: Gently sway the source over time so the field evolves organically while retaining its upward drift.

params: Add a restrained HDR bloom over the brightest golden dust cores.
Create a soft close-range halo without washing the whole black background.
Restrict bloom to bright particle highlights and preserve near-black negative space.
Feather the glow threshold for a natural luminous rolloff.
Retain the crisp bright dust cores beneath the bloom.

prior_iterations.critique: The frame has a convincing near-black background and warm amber particles with soft luminous halos. However, the field is too sparse for fine golden dust: it reads as a few isolated glowing motes, including several comparatively large bright blobs, rather than a rich suspended dust cloud. The supplied render does not visibly provide a t4 comparison, so the intended upward motion cannot be confirmed from the available frame.
